questionText: An asset costing ₦150,000 with a residual value of ₦5,000 is depreciated straight-line over 8 years. What is the annual depreciation?
explanation: (cost − residual) / life = (150,000 − 5,000)/8 = ₦18,125. Charging on the full cost ignores the residual value.
hint: Straight line = (cost − residual) / useful life.

hint: Reducing balance applies the rate to the NET book value.

hint: Appropriate salary and interest first; share the remainder.
